english: adyāpi na nivṛtto me saṁśayaḥ parameśvara / 2a You can translate it in both ways: the outcome from the union of two energies (the Lord and Pārvatī) or [from the] Rudrayāmala Tantra.
nādabindumayaṁ vāpi kiṁ candrārdhanirodhikāḥ cakrārūḍhamanackaṁ vā

O Lord (deva), what is the real essence of the way we have to tread (kiṁ rūpaṁ tattvato deva)? This is one sentence, an exclusive sentence. O Lord, what is the real essence of the way we have to march
